name: The Battle for Wesnoth
hint: Multiplayer server for the turn-based fantasy strategy game, joined over IPv6

MOTD.title: Message of the day
MOTD.default: Welcome to a Cloady Wesnoth server!
MOTD.description: Players join with Wesnoth 1.18 from Multiplayer, Connect to Server, entering the app's address (port 15000 is the default) and any nickname. The address is IPv6-only, so players need IPv6 on their network.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.title: Admin password
ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Type /query admin followed by this password in the lobby to moderate the server.
